title: Props of the show
intro: Visitors light up real models of the show from their phone: a pair of wings, the bats, a row of arches. They pick a prop, one of 12 effects, colours and a speed; the effect plays on top of the sequence, and when it ends the models go back to the show.

fields.label: Props, one a line: icon name | models or groups, separated by commas | across (optional)
fields.hint: Up to 12 props, 64 models each. A group adds all its models. Without "across" each model does the same (a pair of wings); with it, one effect runs over all the models together (a row of arches). A model whose name ends in Left / Right (or L / R) is a wing: the effects start from its body.

fields.text: My colours: visitors may pick 1 to 3 colours of their own
A request for a busy prop waits its turn (off: it replaces the one showing)
